payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sorts array of size reductions (a_i - b_i) descending, then greedily picks largest reductions until total size fits within capacity.
payload.rationale: The algorithm computes difference between original and compressed sizes, sorts these differences in descending order, and iteratively subtracts the largest reductions until total size ≤ m. Sorting is essential: it ensures greedy selection yields minimal number of compressions.
